'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title combat for the wrong side. Drop! (V) start effect with LTM objective. Sidious → [[Senator Palpatine]]. Shield Resistance struck; We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh? used.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Greg Shaw]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Peace|Let Them Make The First Move]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
